column1: # Isaac's voice in the main story: one brief line at each of four moments the
# rewrite raised, in the voice his custom-scene lines already set (brief,

column3: We'll find her. She\nshould hear it from us,\nnot from strangers.{end_wait}
We saw her fall.\nThat's all we know.\nWe'll keep looking.{end_wait}
